_about: Python packages Angelo installs over the pinned precompiled libraries' copies (angelo_python_packages.cmake; doc/angelo/releasing.rst, 'Bundled trust stores'). Pure-Python wheels from PyPI, verified by SHA-256 when downloaded and again when installed. certifi is the root store Angelo's own TLS uses (SSL_CERT_FILE); pip vendors its own copy of certifi. The release check (scripts/angelo/trust_store.py) refuses a bundle whose certifi is older than the newest release on PyPI, so bump these the day certifi publishes. Change a value here, nowhere else.

floors._about: The oldest trust store a release may ship even offline: every certifi copy (vendored ones too) and the bundled Codex's webpki-roots (agent_runtime.json trust_roots). Raise a floor when a release removes a distrusted root.
